reports.title: Anaptys Reports Fiscal First Quarter 2027 Financial Results and

lines: Anaptys continues to expect to achieve >$390 million in annualized Jemperli royalties payable to Anaptys as early as 2029 at GSK’s peak monotherapy sales guidance of >$2.7 billion2

Anaptys estimates Sagard will have accrued ~$330 million in royalties and sales milestones through September 30, 2026 and anticipates paydown of the remaining ~$270 million non-recourse debt monetization in calendar H2 2027
